description:
Get the video and photos of a social media post (X/Twitter, Douyin, Xiaohongshu/RedNote, Instagram) as
        direct download URLs, in one call. Use it whenever the user shares such a link or asks about a post's video or
        pictures: to save, watch, transcribe, describe or analyze them. The files are small (short videos, photos):
        fetch the URLs and work on them directly (at most 3 at once; resume a cut download with an HTTP Range request).
        A post with several photos or videos returns them all (up to 20, `items`) and counts as one free download;
        social posts have their own free allowance (20 a day).

        Files not ready within `wait_seconds` have status "running" and a `job_id`: call `get_job`, then
        `get_download_link`.

tier.description: "free" (own daily allowance for social posts) or "fast" (uses traffic balance)
tier.title: Tier

url.description: Link to a post on X (Twitter), Douyin, Xiaohongshu (RedNote) or Instagram, as the user gave it
url.title: Url

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the files to be ready
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds

name: download_social
title: Download a social media post
